description: Fetch a subgraph's self-describing spec — the tables, columns, filters, and read URLs a consumer needs, without guessing. `agent` (default) returns the compact JSON schema built for tool use, `openapi` the OpenAPI document for the subgraph's read routes, `markdown` human-readable docs. Read it before writing queries against an unfamiliar subgraph.

format.description: agent = JSON schema for tool use (default), openapi = OpenAPI JSON, markdown = docs.md

name: subgraphs_spec
